 ABC7 Chicago Digital Team Thu, November 12, 2026 at 1:10 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. A man on a flight from Tokyo, Japan to Chicago was taken to a hospital after he had to be removed from the plane.
 A United Airlines flight declared an emergency for an unruly passenger Wednesday afternoon.
 ABC7 Chicago is now streaming 24/7. Click here to watch 
 The pilot told air traffic controllers that it was a level three emergency, which is the second highest level.
 Chicago police said a man was taken to a hospital for evaluation after the plane landed at O'Hare airport.
